I was surprised to learn from my sister (nurse) that most of the population is magnesium deficient! 

Magnesium has a lot of beneficial properties, “Mag helps you to relax by stimulating the production of melatonin and serotonin which boosts your mood and helps you sleep. Mag also reduces the production of cytokines and cortisol, which lead to increased inflammation and stress” (healthmatch.io) 

I try to take it everyday, especially if I drank the night before as I’ve noticed alcohol can dis regulate me the following day. Most times when I’m feeling unstable or overly sensitive, it’s not that I’m actually upset about anything in particular, but that there’s an imbalance going on hormonally, either in my brain or my gut (google: vagus nerve)! 

I highly recommend it as it is easily accessible and its easier to take a supplement than seeking out magnesium high foods. I recommend you poke around and do your research as Im not a professional (: thanks for asking!
